Cromwell's rule.subject: Applied Sciences
Cromwell's rule.question: Tim and _____'s probabilities do not converge as more and more heads are thrown
Cromwell's rule.fact: Susan assumes the stranger chose a fair coin (so the prior probability that the tossed coin is the unfair coin is 0). Consequently, Susan calculates the probability that three (or any number of consecutive heads) were tossed with the unfair coin must be 0; if still more heads are thrown, Susan does not change her probability.

Cromwell's rule.fact: If the prior probability assigned to a hypothesis is 0 or 1, then, by Bayes' theorem, the posterior probability (probability of the hypothesis, given the evidence) is forced to be 0 or 1 as well; no evidence, no matter how strong, could have any influence. A strengthened version of Cromwell's rule, applying also to statements of arithmetic and logic, alters the first rule of probability, or the convexity rule, 0 ≤ Pr(A) ≤ 1, to 0 < Pr(A) < 1.

MS-DOS.question: It was not included with _____ 11 as the operating system is exclusively offered in 64-bit architectures such as x86-64
MS-DOS.fact: Windows 9x used MS-DOS to boot the Windows kernel in protected mode. Basic features related to the file system, such as long file names, were only available to DOS applications when running through Windows.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: For example, MS-DOS 4, released in July _____, was followed by DR DOS 5.0 in May 1990
MS-DOS.fact: For example, MS-DOS 4, released in July 1988, was followed by DR DOS 5.0 in May 1990.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: MS-DOS 5.0 came in April _____, and DR DOS 6.0 was released the following June
MS-DOS.fact: MS-DOS 5.0 came in April 1991, and DR DOS 6.0 was released the following June.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: These products are collectively referred to as "DOS", even though "_____" is a generic term used on other systems unrelated to the x86 and IBM PC
MS-DOS.fact: These products are collectively called "DOS", even though "Disk Operating System" is a generic term used on other systems unrelated to the x86 and IBM PC.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: Digital Research had to release interim releases to circumvent _____ limitations inserted artificially, designed specifically to provide Microsoft with a competitive advantage
MS-DOS.fact: Microsoft's control of the Windows platform, and their programming practices which intentionally made Windows appear as if it ran poorly on competing versions of DOS, crippled the ability of other DOS makers to continue to compete with MS-DOS. Digital Research had to release interim releases to circumvent Windows limitations inserted artificially, designed specifically to provide Microsoft with a competitive advantage.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: The VER internal command reports the _____ version 4.00.1111, 4.10.1998, or 4.10.2222 depending on the version of Windows, while applications through the API would report version 7.10
MS-DOS.fact: The VER internal command reports the Windows version 4.00.950, applications through the MS-DOS API would be reported a version number of 7.00. MS-DOS 7.1 was included in Windows 95's OEM Service Release 2 through Windows 98 Second Edition.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: government _____ began investigating Microsoft's licensing procedures, resulting in a 1994 settlement agreement limiting Microsoft to per-copy licensing
MS-DOS.fact: government Federal Trade Commission began investigating Microsoft's licensing procedures, resulting in a 1994 settlement agreement limiting Microsoft to per-copy licensing.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: It was believed that the settlement ran in the order of $_____, but was revealed in November 2009 with the release of the Settlement Agreement to be $280 million
MS-DOS.fact: It was believed that the settlement ran in the order of $150 million, but was revealed in November 2009 with the release of the Settlement Agreement to be $280 million.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: Later, in 1985, _____ 1.0 was released as Microsoft's first attempt at providing a consistent user interface (for applications)
MS-DOS.fact: Later, in 1985, Microsoft Windows 1.0 was released as Microsoft's first attempt at providing a consistent user interface (for applications).

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: With PC DOS 5.00.1, the IBM–_____ agreement started to end, and IBM entered the retail DOS market with IBM DOS 5.00.1, 5.02, 6.00 and PC DOS 6.1, 6.3, 7, 2000 and 7.1
MS-DOS.fact: Microsoft DOS was released through the OEM channel, until Digital Research released DR-DOS 5.0 as a retail upgrade. With PC DOS 5.00.1, the IBM–Microsoft agreement started to end, and IBM entered the retail DOS market with IBM DOS 5.00.1, 5.02, 6.00 and PC DOS 6.1, 6.3, 7, 2000 and 7.1.

MS-DOS.subject: Applied Sciences
MS-DOS.question: When OS/2 was released in 1987, _____ began an advertising campaign announcing that "DOS is Dead" and stating that version 4 was the last full release
MS-DOS.fact: Microsoft and IBM together began what was intended as the follow-on to MS-DOS/PC DOS, called OS/2. When OS/2 was released in 1987, Microsoft began an advertising campaign announcing that "DOS is Dead" and stating that version 4 was the last full release.
